title: The panel controls walk reaches the revert arrow it is written to press
goal: One of the scripted walks that checks the properties panel stops partway through, because the little arrow that puts a copied layer's opacity back to whatever the original says now sits below the bottom of the window. Nothing is checking that part of the app any more. It unblocks the focus: a copy overriding its original and handing the override back is the heart of component design, and nothing else checks it.
notes:
Measured on 2026-09-07 and PROVEN not caused by the stricter press rule that landed the same day: the walk was stashed back to the pre-change build (git stash of PlaytestHarness.swift + PlaytestPanelPress.swift), the probe rebuilt, and it failed at the same step 63 with the OLD message "is not in the window". Its own dump /tmp/photonz-playtest/panel-controls/panel-8-own-opacity.json puts "Revert Opacity" at press point x=1082 y=-10, which is below the window content bottom edge, so the old point-only check rejected it too. Last good run was 2026-09-06 22:41 (panel-9-following-again.json in that folder still carries that timestamp), so it regressed when rows were added to the dock. Likely fix is a scrollPanel step before step 62, the same shape as the fix mixed-one-look-walk got. Same family as the-clip-contents-walk-reaches-the-switch-it-is; the app side of the squeeze is the-properties-panel-fits-on-the-screen-it-has.

Triage 2026-09-07: same root cause as the-clip-contents-walk-reaches-the-switch-it-is and the-properties-panel-fits-on-the-screen-it-has, which is now p1-high. Do the panel one first and re-run this before changing the walk.
acceptance: Scripts/playtest.sh Scripts/playtest/panel-controls-walk.json passes on its own
It passes twice in a row
The walk still checks what it was written to check: an overridden opacity, the revert arrow, and the override going away
If the arrow is out of reach because the panel is too tall, that is said in the log and pointed at the panel task rather than quietly worked around

log.note: Triage 2026-09-07: sequenced behind the-properties-panel-fits-on-the-screen-it-has (now p1-high), which is the shared root cause.
